decision: Proceed to broader synthetic and observational telemetry evaluation; this is not approval for live automated resource changes.
evidence_scope: Internal held-out seeds in prespecified synthetic families only; unadjusted paired percentile intervals conditional on the model.
limitations_to_carry_forward: Surge-only mean backlog is worse than static.
20 of176 paired scenarios are worse than static on mean backlog.
The ensemble does not include arbitrary unseen faults; no formal safety guarantee.
Development terminal backlog was worse than static; validation terminal comparisons remain descriptive.
